info.description:
Memory nodes, cards, and card items API server.
**Authentication:** Use `POST /users/login`, copy `accessToken` from the response, then click **Authorize** and paste it as the `access_token` cookie value. Alternatively, login from Swagger on the same host and cookies are sent automatically.
info.title: MemoryGuard API

get.description: Returns a card item by its ID for the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes a card item by ID owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns all card items for the authenticated user
Returns a card with resolved question/answer card items for the authenticated user
Returns cards for the given JSON ids query parameter owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Returns cards for a memory node (or priority/group), filtered by a simple query string

put.description: Decrements the card count by 1 (not below 0)
Decrements the card practice count by 1 (not below 0)

post.description: Deletes cards by IDs owned by the authenticated user and unlinks them from parent memory nodes
Returns multiple card items by their IDs for the authenticated user
Returns multiple cards by their IDs for the authenticated user
Returns multiple memory nodes by their IDs for the authenticated user

put.description: Increments the card practice count by 1

get.description: Finds a memory node by one of its aliases for the authenticated user
Returns a memory node by its ID for the authenticated user

delete.description: Deletes a memory node by ID owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Returns all memory nodes for the authenticated user, or a subset when ids query is provided as a JSON array

post.description: Creates card items and a card under a memory node for the authenticated user
Creates a new card item owned by the authenticated user
Creates a new memory node owned by the authenticated user

put.description: Partially updates an existing card owned by the authenticated user
Partially updates an existing card item owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Bulk-updates count or practiceCount on multiple cards owned by the authenticated user

put.description: Partially updates an existing memory node owned by the authenticated user

post.description: Logs in a user and returns tokens. Sets auth cookies. Copy accessToken into Authorize for other endpoints.
Revokes refresh token and clears auth cookies
Exchanges a refresh token for a new access and refresh token pair

get.description: Returns a user by their ID
